description: Find coins and tokens by symbol, name or network and get their currency ids. Each id is one coin on one network: usdttrc20 is USDT on TRON, usdterc20 is USDT on Ethereum. Use the ids in get_quote and create_swap.

query.description: Symbol, name or network, for example "usdt", "usdt tron" or "solana".
